listing.description: A whole pumpkin pie with a fluted crust and a dollop of whipped cream, a slice cut and ready, wheat, maple leaves, acorns, cinnamon sticks and star anise, all painted in watercolor. "Pie Season" in round script on top and "save me a slice" below. For Thanksgiving dinner, Friendsgiving and everyone who saves room for dessert.

listing.trademark_check: Legal Desk screen 2026-10-06 (before any art): web searches '"pie season" trademark clothing', '"PIE SEASON" USPTO trademark registration' and '"save me a slice" trademark apparel OR shirt brand'. No PIE SEASON or SAVE ME A SLICE registration, filing or apparel brand found. Pie clothing marks seen use other wording (I [heart] PIE, Mrs. Sullivan's; PIE IN THE SKY; BUTTERMILK PIE CLOTHING; DON'T BE SHY, TRY SOME PIE; P.I.E WEAR 3.14) and are not used. 'Pie season' is used descriptively for the holiday baking season. tmsearch.uspto.gov and Justia are blocked from our sessions, so this is a search-engine screen, not a clearance.
